body.label: Trigger
body.html: An enemy enters your reach, targets you with a close-range Action, or creates an area beneath you.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Move up to 2 units. If you are in a Strider Adaptation, this movement does not trigger Reactions.

surges.html: Increase any movement this Reaction grants by 1 unit.
Increase the reach or affected distance of this Reaction by 1 unit.
